description: This Java class 'BitmapUtils' provides utility functions for loading and processing photos and descriptions for an Android application. It handles loading bitmaps from resources, caching bitmaps, and creating thumbnail images.

classes.name: BitmapUtils
classes.description: A utility class for loading and processing images and descriptions for a photo gallery in an Android app.

methods.name: loadPhotos
methods.description: Loads a list of PictureData objects with randomly selected images and descriptions, preparing thumbnails.

methods.name: getBitmap
methods.description: Retrieves a bitmap from cache or loads it from resources if not cached.

methods.name: getThumbnail
methods.description: Creates a scaled-down thumbnail version of a given bitmap fitting within max dimensions.
